title: Concept: Repository cloned over plaintext HTTP in shell — review required
description: In shell, git clone fetches from an http:// URL. The protocol carries no server authentication, so an attacker on the path can serve a different repository or altered objects and the build compiles them. Even for public code, the substitution happens before any signature check because there is nothing to check.
applicability: shell build scripts, container images, and CI steps.
risk: Source substitution and code disclosure on the wire; MEDIUM severity.
